findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_to_my_wishlist, get_deals, get_product, get_store, get_wishlist, list_brands, list_shares, search_products, share_wishlist · Private data: add_to_wishlist, claim_wishlist, create_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist, reserve_gift, unreserve_gift, update_wishlist · Public sink: claim_wishlist, create_wishlist, get_wishlist, list_shares, reserve_gift, revoke_share, share_wishlist, unreserve_gift · Destructive: remove_from_my_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_to_my_wishlist, get_deals, get_product, get_store, get_wishlist, list_brands, list_shares, search_products, share_wishlist · Private data: add_to_wishlist, claim_wishlist, create_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist, reserve_gift, unreserve_gift, update_wishlist · Public sink: claim_wishlist, create_wishlist, get_wishlist, list_shares, reserve_gift, revoke_share, share_wishlist, unreserve_gift · Destructive: remove_from_my_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "add_to_wishlist" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
